subject_name: Leaders of the stars of command

phase_prompt.label: Phase 1: The Architects of Time
phase_prompt.summary: The Leaders exist in perfect, rhythmic harmony with the simulation's clock. They are the unmoved movers, executing the nightly scripts with cold, beautiful precision.
phase_prompt.prompt_block: Hyper-realistic medium shot. A Leader of the stars, a humanoid construct of black glass and light, stands perfectly still in the void. Veins of steady cyan light pulse rhythmically beneath its surface. It gestures slowly with a gloved hand, guiding a stream of star-data particles along a smooth, curved trajectory. The reflection in its visor shows a perfectly ordered constellation map. The mood is serene, calculated, and awe-inspiring. Clean lines, deep blacks, sharp focus.
